papers.title_en: JointQ: Joint Scale-and-Integer Quantization for Large Language Models
papers.authors: Keiji Kimura, Yuma Ichikawa
papers.evidence: 面向大语言模型的联合尺度与整数量化后训练求解器，改进GPTQ
papers.tldr: GPTQ是逐层训练后量化的事实标准，但其贪心求解将连续组尺度与离散整数分配分开优化，成为精度瓶颈。JointQ把整数候选与闭式最优尺度的联合评估从逐通道扩展到组量化，通过局部搜索每次改一个整数并重算组尺度，周期联合重解全部尺度。在4个模型4种设置下，它在16项比较中14项提升六任务平均零样本准确率、12项改善困惑度。方法保持GPTQ输出格式、可即插即用，主要价值是在低比特和大组场景下保持下游精度。
papers.abstract_en: GPTQ is the de facto standard solver for layer-wise post-training quantization (PTQ) of large language models, yet the solver itself has received less attention than weight preprocessing and cross-layer objectives. We target a bottleneck of GPTQ: its greedy procedure optimizes continuous group scales separately from the assignment of discrete integers. Evaluating each integer candidate with its closed-form optimal scale has been used for per-channel quantization; JointQ extends it to group-wise quantization, where a row's scales are coupled through the Hessian, and applies it to refine the GPTQ solution. Each local-search move changes one integer and recomputes its group's optimal scale in closed form, accounting for the other groups through the full Hessian; all scales are periodically re-solved jointly. The search starts from a row-wise selection among scale-refitted candidates including the GPTQ solution, so unregularized JointQ never has a larger layer-wise calibration error than GPTQ. JointQ preserves the GPTQ output format and is thus a drop-in replacement. Across four models and four settings, JointQ improves six-task average zero-shot accuracy over vanilla GPTQ in 14 of 16 comparisons and perplexity in 12 of 16. The mean accuracy gain increases from 0.0044 in W4G128 to 0.1559 in W3 per-channel, and JointQ also improves average accuracy over GPTQ with MSE-based scale search and activation ordering in all eight per-channel comparisons, though rarely in G128. An ablation shows that JointQ's diagonal Tikhonov regularization mitigates severe W3 per-channel perplexity degradation, so the largest gains are not due to the local search alone. Overall, JointQ's primary empirical benefit is downstream accuracy preservation in challenging low-bit and large-group regimes. Code is available in the OneComp library at https://github.com/FujitsuResearch/OneCompression.

papers.title_en: SoScale: Second-Order Scale Search for FP4 Quantization
papers.authors: Pengxiang Zhao, Xing Li, Hui-Ling Zhen, Weizhe Lin, Xianzhi Yu, Zhenhua Dong
papers.evidence: 面向大模型FP4权重量化的二阶缩放码搜索
papers.tldr: 低比特量化可降低大模型显存与推理成本，但 MXFP4、NVFP4、HiF4 等格式对分块或分层 scale 码敏感，默认最大绝对值缩放易被离群值占用稀缺 FP4 等级。SoScale 将权重 scale 码搜索建模为 Hessian 感知的层重建目标，在硬件有效码中搜索并耦合 GPTQ 式误差恢复，以层输出影响选择 scale。在 Qwen3 上，MXFP4、NVFP4、HiF4 的下游量化退化均被稳定降低，说明二阶尺度搜索能提升 FP4 实用性。
papers.abstract_en: Low-bit quantization reduces the memory footprint and inference cost of large language models (LLMs), yet accurate FP4 quantization remains challenging. Practical formats such as MXFP4, NVFP4, and HiF4 pair a 4-bit floating-point payload with block-wise or hierarchical scale codes, making accuracy highly sensitive to how each local distribution is scaled. Default maximum-absolute-value scaling preserves dynamic range, but can spend scarce FP4 levels on rarely occupied outlier regions and leave dense tensor values poorly resolved. Existing scale-search methods minimize local element-wise reconstruction error, optimizing tensor fidelity rather than layer-output fidelity. We propose SoScale, a second-order weight scale-code search method for hierarchical FP4 quantization. SoScale searches hardware-valid scale codes under a Hessian-aware layer reconstruction objective and couples this search with GPTQ-style error recovery, selecting scales by their impact on layer outputs. Across Qwen3 models, SoScale consistently reduces downstream quantization degradation under MXFP4, NVFP4, and HiF4.

papers.title_en: SignRot: LLM Quantization with Massive Outlier-Aware Sign-Adjusted Rotation
papers.authors: Jaehun Gim, Jaewoo Kim, Gyuwan Kim, Seo Yeon Park
papers.evidence: 用符号调整旋转处理大规模离群激活的LLM量化
papers.tldr: 大模型量化常受激活中巨量离群值拖累，尤其下投影输入处的离群值会使随机Hadamard旋转产生碎片化分布，破坏均匀量化。SignRot识别巨量离群通道，构造符号调整向量统一对应Hadamard行符号，把双峰分布折叠为单峰，并配合非对称激活量化吸收均值偏移。它只需一次校准前向和推理时逐元素符号翻转，可作为即插即用模块兼容现有Hadamard量化方法。在LLaMA3-70B上，SignRot+QuaRot取得WikiText2困惑度5.88与零样本推理平均准确率72.73，超过SpinQuant。
papers.abstract_en: While quantization compresses LLMs and accelerates inference, outlier activations impede efficient low-bit representation. In particular, massive outliers cause substantial performance degradation. Although rotation-based methods that rely on randomized Hadamard transforms for online inference aim to mitigate this, they can produce fragmented distributions with empty bins when a massive outlier dominates a token's activation. This fragmentation severely undermines uniform quantization performance. Moreover, massive outliers concentrate in the down-projection input, where the preceding nonlinearity requires the rotation to be applied at inference time. This constraint prevents training-based approaches such as SpinQuant from learning the online rotation at this position, as a learned dense matrix cannot use the Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform and would require a full matrix multiplication during inference. To address this, we propose SignRot (Sign-adjusted Rotation), which identifies massive outlier channels and constructs a sign adjustment vector that unifies the signs of the corresponding Hadamard row, collapsing the bimodal distribution into a unimodal profile amenable to quantization. Since the aligned outlier shifts the activation mean away from zero, we pair SignRot with asymmetric activation quantization, whose zero-point absorbs this shift. As a lightweight, drop-in improvement compatible with any Hadamard-based quantization method, SignRot requires only a single calibration forward pass and adds only element-wise sign flips at inference, without an additional matrix multiplication. Applying SignRot to QuaRot achieves a WikiText2 perplexity of 5.88 and an average zero-shot reasoning accuracy of 72.73, surpassing SpinQuant on the LLaMA3-70B model. Code is available at https://github.com/HYU-ARK-Lab/SignRot.

papers.title_en: Vision-Language-Action Models: A Life-Cycle Survey of Design, Training and Deployment
papers.authors: Suvarna Kadam, Soran Parsa
papers.evidence: 面向机器人控制的视觉-语言-动作模型全生命周期综述，涵盖操作、导航与人形控制
papers.tldr: VLA将预训练视觉语言模型扩展到机器人动作输出，使网络知识迁移到物理控制。该综述覆盖2022年12月至2026年10月的89项工作，沿模型设计、训练与部署三条生命周期轴展开，并对比22个模型的训练数据、参数量、推理速度与硬件。文章总结数据来源扩展、模型规模两极化和通用VLA兴起三大趋势，还讨论世界动作模型与评测失效问题，为跨领域研究者和实践者提供设计默认值与术语表。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models adapt web-pretrained vision-language models to output robot actions, so that web knowledge carries over to physical control. In under four years the field has grown from RT-2, the first VLA, to open models that fine-tune on a single consumer GPU and proprietary generalists that clean unseen homes. VLA research joins robotics, computer vision and language modelling, so this survey is written for researchers and practitioners from each of these fields. It reviews 89 works from December 2022 to October 2026, mainly on manipulation and navigation, plus humanoid control, world-action models and evaluation. Seven design axes follow a VLA's life cycle: model design (inputs and memory, architecture, action output, intermediate predictions), training (pretraining data, post-training) and deployment (real-time execution). We compare 22 models on these axes, with their training data, model size, inference speed and hardware. Three trends emerge. (i) Training data has broadened beyond teleoperated robot data (about 10,000 hours for $π_0$) to community-collected episodes and egocentric human video (20,000 hours for GR00T N1.7). (ii) Model sizes have split into two groups: most recent models have 3-7 billion parameters; a new group under one billion runs on consumer GPUs. (iii) Generalist VLAs handling both manipulation and navigation are emerging, such as UniVLA and Qwen-VLA. We also compare VLAs with world-action models, which predict future observations as well as actions, and review evidence that some VLAs with near-perfect benchmark scores fail after small scene changes. A practitioner's guide gives a default for each design decision, and a glossary supports readers new to the field.

papers.title_en: Bring Back Language to Actions: Restoring VLM capabilities in VLA Models via Parameter Merging
papers.authors: Mohamed Salim Aissi, Olivier Sigaud, Laure Soulier, Nicolas Thome
papers.evidence: 合并VLM与VLA权重以恢复语言能力并从视觉语言输入预测动作
papers.tldr: VLA模型由VLM在机器人演示数据上微调得到，但微调会引发灾难性遗忘，削弱原VLM的语义理解与视觉定位能力。作者提出免重训的参数合并方法：提取VLA与VLM的权重差作为任务向量，经SVD分解后为每个分量学习标量混合系数。该系数以同时保持动作预测和视觉语言能力为目标优化。实验表明合并模型在两类能力上均表现良好，并稳定优于已有合并基线。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are obtained by fine-tuning pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on robot demonstration data, enabling action prediction from visual observations and language instructions. However, this fine-tuning induces catastrophic forgetting, substantially degrading the semantic and visual grounding capabilities of the original VLM. We address this by merging the parameters of a VLM and its VLA derivative without retraining either model. Concretely, we extract the task vector (the difference between VLA and VLM weights) and decompose it via Singular Value Decomposition. For each component, we learn a scalar mixing coefficient controlling how much of the VLA adaptation is retained, optimised to jointly preserve action prediction and vision-language capabilities. Experiments show that our merged model performs well on both axes simultaneously, consistently outperforming established merging baselines.

papers.title_en: NVFP4-MLA: Unified FP4 KV-Cache Storage and Attention Computation for Multi-Head Latent Attention
papers.authors: Chao Ni, Qi Zhang, Xiao Wang, Zongfei Jing, Mingyang Hao, Binghan Chen, Kefeng Duan, Yu-Jung Chen, Mengdi Wang, Tijmen Blankevoort, Jun Yang
papers.evidence: FP4 KV缓存量化与注意力内核协同设计
papers.tldr: 长上下文与智能体负载使 MLA 的 KV 缓存容量和注意力计算成为服务前沿大模型的主要成本。NVFP4-MLA 首次将 MLA 的 KV 缓存存储与注意力计算同时推进到 FP4，并联合设计量化算法、注意力核与缓存系统：选择性残差补偿只作用于量化敏感通道，二维量化块使共享潜在缓存兼容两个注意力 BMM 的不同归约方向，避免二次量化。在 DeepSeek-R1 与 Kimi-K3 上，它在九项基准上匹配 BF16 MLA 平均精度，KV 缓存分别压缩 3.20x 和 3.05x，注意力核较 FP8 MLA 最高加速 2.82x 和 2.71x。
papers.abstract_en: Long-context reasoning and agentic workloads make key-value (KV) cache capacity and attention computation the dominant costs of serving frontier large language models. We present NVFP4-MLA, the first design to push both KV-cache storage and attention computation of multi-head latent attention (MLA) to FP4. NVFP4-MLA co-designs the quantization algorithm with the attention kernel and the cache system. Selective residual compensation preserves model accuracy by adding NVFP4 residuals only to the quantization-sensitive channels. Two-dimensional quantization blocks make the shared latent cache compatible with the different reduction directions of the two attention batched matrix multiplications (BMMs), removing requantization between them. On DeepSeek-R1 and Kimi-K3, NVFP4-MLA matches BF16 MLA average accuracy across nine benchmarks while compressing the MLA KV cache by 3.20x and 3.05x relative to BF16 MLA. On NVIDIA Rubin GPUs, NVFP4-MLA speeds up the attention kernel over FP8 MLA by up to 2.82x on DeepSeek-R1 and 2.71x on Kimi-K3, and lowers p90 time to first token in agentic multi-turn serving by up to 3.5x and 2.1x, respectively. In disaggregated DeepSeek-R1 serving, it also raises per-GPU throughput by up to 2.30x.

papers.title_en: MARS: Dynamic Routing of Reinforcement-Learned Atomic Skills for Multi-Stage Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Zequan Zeng, Junqin Yang, Kai Wang
papers.evidence: 面向机器人操作的VLA模型与动态技能路由
papers.tldr: 针对VLA模型在抓取、对齐与插入等关键操作阶段控制精度和执行稳定性不足的问题，MARS将冻结的通用VLA策略与多个独立训练的强化学习原子技能策略结合，并通过共享RL Token状态表示和动态路由器协调多策略。路由器利用Mamba循环编码、历史特征窗口及技能语义注意力选择技能。在LIBERO四套任务上Macro-F1达90.47%，Tube Transport全任务成功率由20.04%升至85.67%。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in multi-task robotic manipulation. However, they still face limitations in control precision and execution stability during critical manipulation stages, such as object grasping, alignment and insertion. To combine general-purpose manipulation capabilities with task-specific fine-grained control, while enabling effective coordination between generalist and specialized policies throughout multi-stage manipulation tasks, this paper proposes MARS (Modular Atomic-skill Routing System), a dynamic routing framework for reinforcement learning-based atomic skills. MARS integrates a frozen generalist VLA policy with multiple independently trained atomic skill policies. Using a shared RL Token state representation and the reference action of VLA, specialized control policies are optimized through reinforcement learning for different cr`itical manipulation stages. For high-level policy selection, we develop a dynamic router that integrates temporal context and skill semantics. The router employs Mamba-based recurrent encoding and a historical feature window to capture state evolution during manipulation. Skill descriptions of candidate policies are encoded into semantic queries, and attention mechanisms are used to establish correspondences between skill semantics and temporal state features. Experimental results show that MARS achieves an average Macro-F1 score of 90.47% across four LIBERO task suites under fixed-trajectory evaluation, outperforming an MLP-based router by 7.08 percentage points. In the simulated Tube Transport task, the full-task success rate increases from 20.04% to 85.67%. These results demonstrate that stage-specific reinforcement learning and temporal state-aware dynamic policy routing can improve multi-policy coordination and overall task execution performance in multi-stage robotic manipulation.

papers.title_en: MIAO: Microscaling Intermediate Accumulation Optimization
papers.authors: Chloe Wong, Nicolas Rakela, Man Shi, Hansung Kim, Ruohan Richard Yan, Coleman Richard Charles Hooper, Yakun Sophia Shao
papers.evidence: 微缩放量化与中间累加优化用于低精度大语言模型推理。
papers.tldr: MX量化能降低LLM推理的乘法与存储成本，但累加常保持高浮点精度，成为脉动阵列等加速器未解决的硬件开销。MIAO通过软硬件协同设计联合选择乘积精度与分级累加器位宽，结合MX块尺度校准、硬件代价估计与精度预测器搜索配置，并用逐位一致的端到端LLM评估验证。在MXFP8/6/4上，相较全BF16累加，PE阵列面积最多降38.7%、能耗最多降36.1%，仅比仅操作数量化多至多1.60%困惑度退化。表明分级精度定制可在端到端精度约束下显著降低硬件成本。
papers.abstract_en: Microscaling (MX) quantization enables lower-precision large language model (LLM) inference with limited accuracy degradation, reducing memory requirement and multiplication cost. However, despite reduced operand precision, accumulation is often retained at high floating-point precisions, leaving a substantial hardware cost that operand quantization alone does not address. In particular, systolic arrays, as used in tensor accelerators such as Google TPU and AWS Trainium, distribute accumulation across distinct processing elements but conventionally use uniform accumulator precision throughout the array. This spatial organization offers an opportunity to reduce hardware cost by tailoring precision to individual accumulation stages.   In this work, we present MIAO, a hardware-software co-design framework that jointly selects product precision and stage-dependent accumulator widths to minimize hardware area and energy cost under an end-to-end perplexity constraint. MIAO first calibrates MX block-scale shifts to reduce intermediate magnitudes while preserving operand quantization accuracy, then assigns narrower accumulators to earlier stages and progressively wider accumulators to later stages. To efficiently explore the resulting design space, MIAO combines hardware cost estimates derived from logic synthesis with a calibrated accuracy predictor to identify promising precision configurations, then validates the accuracy of promising candidates through bit-exact end-to-end LLM evaluation. Across MXFP8, MXFP6, and MXFP4, MIAO reduces processing element (PE) array area by up to 38.7% and energy by up to 36.1% relative to the all-BF16 accumulation baseline, with at most 1.60% additional perplexity degradation over operand-only MX quantization across six LLMs.

papers.title_en: NF-VLA: A Normalizing-Flow Baseline for Vision-Language-Action Learning
papers.authors: Ruichen Deng, Qinyu Zhao, Yong-Hyun Park, Mutian Tong, Liang Zheng, Jiatao Gu
papers.evidence: 用归一化流训练视觉-语言-动作策略进行机器人操作
papers.tldr: 连续机器人动作的VLA策略通常依赖复杂训练目标或额外去噪模块。NF-VLA把条件自回归归一化流与分数修正结合，用单一最大似然目标联合训练视觉-语言骨干和可逆动作变换，并在推理时复用同一密度修正生成动作。无需机器人预训练，它在LIBERO四套件达到98.35%成功率，LIBERO-Plus同检查点达72.6%。这证明结构化的自回归流可作为有竞争力的VLA基线。
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive normalizing flows (NFs) provide a tractable density for learning and sampling continuous robot actions. We show that a single maximum-likelihood objective can train vision--language--action (VLA) policies competitive with leading methods on manipulation benchmarks. We present NF-VLA, which combines conditional autoregressive normalizing flows with score-based action refinement. Its deep--shallow architecture concentrates visual, language, and proprioceptive prefix conditioning in a high-capacity deep block, while unconditioned shallow blocks provide a shared invertible action transformation. The vision--language backbone and flow are jointly trained by exact maximum likelihood on Gaussian-smoothed action chunks. The same learned density supplies a single score-based correction at inference, refining generated actions to account for training-time smoothing without a separately trained denoiser. Trained on LIBERO from a pretrained vision--language backbone without robot pretraining, NF-VLA achieves 98.35\% success across the four standard suites and 72.6\% on LIBERO-Plus using the same checkpoint without further fine-tuning. Ablations show that deep-only prefix conditioning and score-based refinement both improve closed-loop success. Together, these results establish carefully structured autoregressive flows as a competitive approach to VLA control, with one learned density supporting policy training, action generation, and refinement.

papers.title_en: Stochastic Self-Distillation for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Jingru Guo, Alessandra Russo, Joey Bose, Christos Ziakas
papers.evidence: 自蒸馏基于流的VLA策略以支持机器人控制的在线强化学习微调
papers.tldr: 基于流的VLA模型在模仿学习中表现优异，但在线强化学习受限于多步ODE采样带来的高延迟与低随机性。VLA-SSD将预训练流匹配动作头自蒸馏为以布朗路径为条件的随机一步策略，并推导条件动作密度以支持似然比RL后训练。从π0蒸馏后动作头前向耗时降至7.7倍加速，LIBERO成功率相对下降5.5%；利用更高样本多样性对π0.5做GRPO后训练，成功率相对提升20.6%。
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models achieve strong performance in robotics through imitation learning, yet fine-tuning them with on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is limited. In group-based RL methods like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), every rollout step requires multi-step ODE integration, and the sampler's limited stochasticity leads to rollout groups with low variance. We propose VLA-SSD, which addresses both high inference latency and limited stochasticity. In particular, our method self-distills a pretrained flow-matching action head into a stochastic one-step policy by conditioning a single-jump generator on a Brownian path. We derive a conditional action density via our stochastic one-step policy, enabling efficient post-training via likelihood-ratio RL algorithms. We show that distilling VLA-SSD from the $π_0$ VLA reduces the action head's forward-pass time by a factor of 7.7, at the cost of a 5.5% relative decrease in the success rate on the LIBERO benchmark. However, by leveraging the increased sample diversity of VLA-SSD during group generation, post-training a $π_{0.5}$ VLA using GRPO yields a 20.6% relative improvement.

papers.title_en: MiSTiQ: MicroScaling Trellis Quantization for Extreme KV Cache Compression
papers.authors: Ofir Gordon, Lior Dikstein, Paul Balanca, Idan Achituve, Douglas Orr, Hai Victor Habi
papers.evidence: 结合微缩放格式的网格编码KV缓存量化
papers.tldr: 长上下文与大并发推高KV缓存开销，现有码本向量量化受硬件码本大小限制且注意力需反量化到高精度浮点。MiSTiQ用格状编码存储结合MX低精度计算，以beam search在大重建空间编码，并推导MX-Hash直接在目标MX元素格式生成重建值。在Llama3和Qwen3上约1.25有效比特/元素时，取得更低WikiText困惑度和更高GSM8K准确率，NVFP4下LongBench平均最佳。这为极端KV缓存压缩提供可替代码本量化的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Modern large language models (LLMs) increasingly support longer contexts and serve more concurrent requests, increasing both sequence lengths and batch sizes. Both trends increase KV-cache size and memory traffic during inference. KV-cache quantization reduces these costs, with recent approaches using codebook-based vector quantization to achieve extremely low bit widths. However, hardware constraints limit codebook size, and most methods reconstruct the cache in higher-precision floating-point formats for attention, limiting the computational benefits of quantization. To address these limitations, we introduce MiSTiQ, a drop-in replacement for codebook-based vector quantizers that combines trellis-coded storage with microscaling (MX) formats for low-precision computation. We combine trellis quantization with beam search to encode the KV cache over large reconstruction spaces without large codebooks. To support MX computation, we derive MX-Hash functions that generate reconstruction values directly in the target MX element format. These functions use the scale-conditioned marginal distribution of block-normalized Gaussian inputs. On Llama3 and Qwen3, MiSTiQ achieves lower WikiText perplexity and higher GSM8K accuracy than the evaluated baselines across several block-scale formats at approximately 1.25 effective bits per element. With NVFP4, it also achieves the highest LongBench average on both models.

papers.title_en: ScaleVLA: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models to 552 Billion Parameters
papers.authors: Ruixi Yu, Dairu Liu, Xuchuan Chen, Zekun Qi, Zekai Li, Zhuo Cao, Luyang Niu, Yingsheng Zhang, Sikai Liang, Ke Fan, He Wang, Li Yi
papers.evidence: 将视觉-语言-动作模型扩展至5520亿参数用于机器人学习与控制。
papers.tldr: 现有VLA策略多依赖较小VLM主干，前沿规模表征在机器人学习中的潜力尚未充分挖掘。ScaleVLA将552B参数的DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash主干与可训练action DiT连接，并在统一训练设置下系统比较2B至552B的VLM。仅10条演示即达87.8%，优于2B主干用50条的85.6%；LIBERO-PRO成功率45.1%，真实充电器插入从4/10提升到9/10。该工作表明前沿VLM可作为高效、可泛化机器人策略的表征基础。
papers.abstract_en: Frontier Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in robot control, suggesting that broad pretraining provides knowledge valuable for physical action. Yet most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies still rely on much smaller VLM backbones, leaving this potential largely untapped. We ask whether frontier-scale representations can provide a stronger foundation for robot learning. We introduce ScaleVLA, which connects a 552B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backbone to a trainable action DiT, and systematically compare VLMs from 2B to 552B under a shared training setup. We evaluate three fundamental capabilities of robot foundation models. In sample efficiency, just 10 demonstrations outperform a 2B backbone trained with 50 (87.8% vs. 85.6%). In generalization, LIBERO-PRO success reaches 45.1%, compared with at most 31.3% for smaller backbones. In precise manipulation, real-world charger insertion improves from 4/10 to 9/10 successes, with gains concentrated in contact-sensitive alignment. Despite its scale, ScaleVLA achieves 216 ms median latency per action chunk. Our findings suggest that frontier VLMs can serve not only as reasoning agents, but also as powerful representational foundations for efficient and generalizable robot policies.

papers.title_en: Beyond Bitwidth: Deployment-Constrained Mixed-Precision Quantization for Multilingual LLM Inference on NVIDIA Blackwell
papers.authors: Hyojung Han
papers.evidence: Blackwell上面向LLM推理内核的部署约束混合精度量化
papers.tldr: 低比特LLM量化需兼顾精度、GPU内核支持与内存/延迟约束；本文在B200/vLLM上研究Qwen3-8B的INT2/INT3、GPTQ、NVFP4与混合精度。作者验证144个融合线性模块的打包执行，并按预注册门控评估多语言与推理质量。最终16比特激活、98个NVFP4权重模块、46个INT8模块和INT8输出头的方案在FINAL-81通过全部门控，权重内存5.917 GiB、韩语保留率0.904、TPOT比0.939。相较NVFP4 W4A4配对精度提升1.4个百分点，但检查点未保留、逐位复现未验证。
papers.abstract_en: Low-bit LLM quantization is useful only if a model preserves service-relevant accuracy, executes through supported GPU kernels, and meets measured memory and latency limits. We study Qwen3-8B on NVIDIA B200 with vLLM, including INT2/INT3, GPTQ, NVFP4, and mixed-precision configurations. We verify native packed execution and precision on all 144 fused linear modules and evaluate Korean, English, numerical, and reasoning quality under preregistered gates. Packed INT2 and INT3 execute, but all seven tested INT2 grids degenerate on generation. Isolated module-restoration effects are strongly non-additive; Korean and reasoning sensitivity rankings disagree, and a promising INT4/INT8 development candidate fails independent final evaluation. A configuration with 16-bit activations, 98 NVFP4 weight-only modules, 46 INT8 modules, and an INT8 output head passes all gates on the untouched FINAL-81 set (5,168 items): 5.917 GiB of weight-loading memory (limit 5.98), Korean teacher-correct retention 0.904 (gate 0.90), and TPOT ratio 0.939 relative to BF16. It improves paired accuracy over NVFP4 W4A4 by +1.4 percentage points (Bonferroni-adjusted interval [+0.2, +2.6]), compared with +3.4 points on the selection set. This comparison changes both activation precision and INT8 protection; exploratory analyses suggest that the activation change contributes substantially, but the isolated allocation effect is not established. Final checkpoints were not retained, and bitwise rebuild reproducibility remains unverified.

papers.title_en: InteractVLA: Turning VLAs into Interactive Tools for Agentic Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Chen Zhao, Zipeng Ye, Shifeng Bao, Yihan Lin, Haitao Shen, Yining Luo, Yuchen Xie, Jing Zhang
papers.evidence: 将预训练视觉-语言-动作策略变为可操控的机器人操作工具
papers.tldr: 现有智能体操作把预训练VLA当作仅接受语言的黑箱原语，策略失败时无法引导，只能重试或人工接管。InteractVLA用双向几何接口把流式VLA变成可操控、可检查工具：前向以测试时几何引导和软时间目标对齐生成动作，反向回传动作块与相机重投影供智能体诊断修正。在LIBERO-Plus、RoboDojo、RoboCasa365上分别达99.4%、48.62%、89.4%。该工作提升在线工具使用并支持递归自我改进。
papers.abstract_en: Existing agentic manipulation systems treat pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies as opaque, language-only primitives: when a policy call fails under unfamiliar instructions or scene perturbations, the agent cannot steer its behavior and is forced into futile retries or costly manual takeover. We present InteractVLA, a framework that turns pretrained flow-based VLAs into geometrically steerable and inspectable tools through a bidirectional geometric interface with vision-language agents. In the forward direction, test-time geometric guidance translates an agent-specified end-effector target into input gradients through the action expert via a differentiable command-to-pose mapping, while soft-time target alignment treats arrival time as a latent execution index to match the target pose without distorting the policy's approach motion. In the reverse direction, action-informed agentic refinement exposes generated action chunks and calibrated camera reprojections back to the agent, allowing it to diagnose spatial discrepancies, revise targets for subsequent VLA calls, or locally adjust motion segments on top of the guided trajectory. Making the VLA controllable not only boosts online agentic tool use, but also unlocks effective recursive self-improvement (RSI), achieving state-of-the-art performance of 99.4\% on LIBERO-Plus, 48.62\% on RoboDojo, and 89.4\% on RoboCasa365. Project page: https://lingwupro.github.io/InteractVLA/.

papers.title_en: HADVQ: Hessian Aware Directional Vector Quantization
papers.authors: Daniil Li, Mars Davletshin, Vadim Klyzhenko, Artem Danilishin, Valery Sandul, Daniil Ryazanov, Ekaterina Muravleva
papers.evidence: 面向大语言模型权重的超低位向量量化与敏感通道处理
papers.tldr: 大语言模型超低比特量化会严重扭曲参数，并集中损害少数高敏感通道。HADVQ 先用随机预条件正则化权重空间，再在极坐标下解耦方向与幅值，用基于 E8 格的结构化码本量化方向。它还用代理 Hessian 检测极重要通道，并以仅 0.16 比特的额外开销保留这些通道。实验显示精度提升，验证了几何结构、格码本与选择性通道保留的组合价值。
papers.abstract_en: Ultra-low-bit quantization of large language models is a challenging task because aggressive compression severely distorts model parameters and disproportionately harms a small number of highly sensitive channels. We present a vector quantization method tailored for this regime. Our approach begins with random preconditioning, which regularizes the weight space and makes it more amenable to quantization. We then represent weights in polar coordinates and decouple the quantization of directions and magnitudes. To quantize directions, we leverage the structure induced by random preconditioning and design a structured codebook based on the $E_8$ lattice, yielding a compact yet expressive representation. To further reduce degradation, we detect extremely important channels using a proxy Hessian and preserve them with an additional cost of only 0.16 bits. Together, these components provide an effective quantization pipeline for LLMs in the extremely low-bit regime. Empirical results demonstrate improved accuracy, highlighting the benefit of combining geometric structure, lattice-based codebooks, and selective channel preservation.

papers.title_en: QDA: Closed-Loop LLM Quantization Design with Agents
papers.authors: Xingyang Li, Tianlang Zhao, Song Han, Ligeng Zhu
papers.evidence: 智能体驱动的闭环大语言模型训练后量化配方设计
papers.tldr: 大模型低比特部署需为每个模型和精度重新设计PTQ配方，专家耗时且常次优。QDA让LLM智能体闭环迭代候选构建与评估，用未见推理轨迹上的KL散度分钟级打分，并用长生成复查循环失败。在四个推理模型上，W4A16/W4A8/W3A16分别平均提升0.9、1.4、2.2个百分点；GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4 W4A4恢复FP8精度98.3%。且检查点兼容现有服务内核、无推理开销，将公开库、评估器与框架。
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization is the standard way to serve large language models at low cost. However, the best quantization recipe differs across models and precisions. As a result, experts must redesign it for every new model, which is time-consuming and often sub-optimal. Fortunately, an LLM agent can take over this design by refining the recipe over rounds of building and evaluating candidates, so that more rounds lead to better recipes. However, evaluating one quantized reasoning model takes tens of GPU-hours, and combining methods from different codebases means porting each to the new architecture by hand. We present QDA, a system in which an agent designs the recipe for each model and precision. To make evaluation fast, QDA scores each candidate in minutes by its output KL divergence from the original model on reasoning traces that the agent never sees, and checks promising ones with long generations to catch failures such as repetition loops. To make building fast, QDA provides a library of public PTQ methods that are compatible with one another and with new model architectures. Across four reasoning models, QDA improves accuracy over the strongest public recipe by 0.9, 1.4 and 2.2 percentage points on average at W4A16, W4A8 and W3A16, using 64 GPU-hours per search. On the 320B-parameter MoE model GLM-5.3-Flash at NVFP4 W4A4, it recovers 98.3% of the FP8 model's accuracy, against 96.9% for the best vendor checkpoint. Every QDA checkpoint also runs on existing serving kernels with no inference overhead. We will release the library, the evaluator and the harness.

papers.title_en: MoMoVL: Modality-Aware Adaptive Compression for On-Device Sparsely-Activated Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Dongkeun Lee, Wonjun Lee
papers.evidence: 面向端侧MoE视觉语言模型的混合精度量化与模态感知自适应压缩
papers.tldr: 面向端侧视觉语言模型，MoE 架构虽提升计算效率，却因多专家参数带来显著内存压力。MoMoVL 针对视觉与文本 token 的模态差异，联合专家激活画像和模态量化敏感度，为每个专家自适应分配混合精度位宽。实验在精度-压缩权衡上优于现有混合精度基线，内存最多降低15.44%，仅较统一精度基线小幅掉点。该工作将模态感知引入 MoE-VLM 端侧压缩，提升部署可行性。
papers.abstract_en: The rise of the agentic web has been accompanied by growing demand for on-device Vision-Language Models (VLMs) that perform diverse cross-modal web tasks with enhanced privacy and reduced latency. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are widely adopted in modern VLMs for compute-efficient scalability, yet their multi-expert architecture poses deployment challenges due to substantial memory demands. Mixed-precision quantization is an effective compression technique that reduces bit-widths while adapting to the heterogeneous hardware budgets of edge devices, particularly well-suited for MoE due to its inherent structural sparsity, which causes imbalanced importance among experts. While prior work has applied quantization for efficient MoE inference at the edge, we point out that in MoE-based VLMs, the modality-specific characteristics of visual and text tokens further impact expert quantization. To address this issue, we present MoMoVL, a modality-aware adaptive compression framework for MoE-based VLMs that brings vision-language inference within reach of on-device resource budgets. Motivated by our empirical findings on modality-induced disparities across experts, MoMoVL jointly exploits the per-expert activation profile and per-modality quantization sensitivity to guide bit-width assignment. Experimental results show that MoMoVL improves the accuracy-compression trade-off relative to state-of-the-art mixed-precision baselines and reduces memory footprint by up to 15.44% with a modest drop in accuracy over its uniform-precision baseline. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/sco-edge/MoMoVL.

papers.title_en: RePlan-VLA: Progress-Aware Replanning for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Apoorva Vashisth, Manav Kulshrestha, Damon Conover, Zachary Kingston, Aniket Bera
papers.evidence: 面向长时程机器人操作的VLA无关进度感知重规划。
papers.tldr: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在需要多次相互依赖操作的长时程任务上性能明显下降。RePlan-VLA 提出与具体 VLA 无关的框架，把 VLA 的短时程操作能力嵌入执行感知流程：显式监测机器人运动以评估进度，并据此自适应修订后续计划，且完全保留原策略、无需微调。在 RoboCasa365 与 CALVIN 上成功率分别比最强基线提升 21.9% 和 10.4%，并在 Franka Research 3 真机上完成验证。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet their performance often degrades on long-horizon tasks that require multiple interdependent manipulations. Instead of burdening the VLA policies with long-horizon reasoning, memory, action generation, progress tracking, and error recovery, we argue for leveraging their short-horizon manipulation capabilities within an execution-aware framework. To this end, we introduce \textnormal{\textbf{RePlan-VLA}}, a VLA-agnostic framework that translates a VLA's short-horizon capabilities into reliable long-horizon execution. RePlan-VLA explicitly monitors the robot's motion for progress evaluation, and adaptively revises the future plan based on observed outcomes. We preserve the underlying VLA policy entirely, requiring no additional fine-tuning. Experiments on RoboCasa365 and CALVIN benchmarks show an improvement of 21.9% and 10.4% in success rate over the next strongest baseline. We also validate our approach for real-world deployment on a Franka Research 3 robot.

papers.title_en: Hardware Acceleration of Vision-Language-Action Models with Weight Precision Rising over the Flow Steps
papers.authors: Robin Geens, Simon Haepers, Jonas Crols, Chao Fang, Marian Verhelst
papers.evidence: 通过随流步提升权重量化精度加速VLA动作头硬件推理
papers.tldr: VLA动作头在流匹配推理中每步都要从DRAM重读全部权重，却只作用于约五十个token，因而严重受限于权重传输位宽。作者发现后续流步骤会衰减前步量化误差，故让权重精度随步骤从2位升至4位，无需校准或训练即可保持机器人闭环成功率，且比全程4位少传25%比特。为利用该逐步骤精度，设计可按传输比特缩放延迟与能耗的可编程加速器，用位串行子阵列、熵解码和运行时分配器平衡线性层与注意力负载。在GR00T N1.6上以2/3/3/4位运行，单次推理8.02 ms，较Thor NVFP4快1.7倍、能耗低9.1倍。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models such as GR00T control robots through an action head: a diffusion transformer that turns noise into a chunk of actions in a few flow-matching steps. Every step re-reads all of the head's weights from DRAM but applies each weight to only about fifty tokens. Inference is therefore memory-bound, and its latency and energy are largely determined by the total number of transferred weight bits. We show that later flow steps attenuate the quantization errors of earlier steps, so the weight precision of an action head should rise over the steps. With plain per-channel rounding and without calibration or training, widths rising over the steps from 2 to 4 bits preserve the closed-loop success of robot policies. These widths transfer 25% fewer bits than 4-bit weights at every step. However, we show that on Jetson AGX Thor, current GPU kernels cannot exploit this per-step precision due to fixed overheads. We therefore present a programmable accelerator whose latency and energy both scale with the transferred weight bits. It decodes entropy-coded weights for bit-serial sub-arrays at the DRAM rate. Because the width changes per step, a run-time allocator divides these sub-arrays between the linear layers and the attention to balance their workloads. The same sub-arrays are thus capable of running action heads of different families and sizes, as well as a vision-language model. On the DRAM side, a requantizer and an entropy encoder at each bank let one stored 8-bit copy replace the copies of all widths. Simulated with LPDDR5X timing, our RTL implementation runs the GR00T N1.6 action head in 8.02 ms per inference with 2, 3, 3 and 4 bits in its four flow steps. With a copy per width and 50% of Thor's memory bandwidth, the accelerator runs this schedule 1.7x faster than Thor in NVFP4, at 9.1x less energy and equal closed-loop success.

papers.title_en: SHAPE: Discrete Supervision and Parallel Continuous Streams for Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Human Data
papers.authors: Yaping Li, Zhihong Liu, Jiacheng Li, Yi Yang, Wenchao Yue, Mingzhe Ye, Xiangcheng Liu, Yiyang Chen, Haotian He, Qi Zhang, Haonan Wang, Dahua Lin, Zhijie Deng
papers.evidence: 面向灵巧机器人操作的视觉-语言-动作模型
papers.tldr: 人类第一人称数据成本低，但缺少机器人关节与执行器监督，仅能提供重定向末端动作。SHAPE以VLA骨干预测末端动作块离散token作辅助监督，并用共享流匹配专家并行输出末端与关节两条可执行流。在22自由度双手平台上，离散监督促进跨域动作表征学习；部署时关节直读在六任务达0.80，优于π0.5的0.63，末端IK读出更利于人机迁移。该工作表明仅用人类数据预训练即可学习新灵巧操作任务。
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric human recordings are far cheaper than dexterous robot demonstrations, promising stronger pretraining and direct skill learning without task-specific robot data. Yet humans and robots differ in morphology and kinematics, so human recordings lack the joint positions and actuator commands that supervise robot policies, providing only retargeted end-effector (EEF) actions. This raises two questions: how human data should supervise the policy, and how a dexterous robot should read out actions at deployment. We address both in SHAPE (Supervision from Human Action tokens with Parallel Executable streams), a vision-language-action (VLA) model whose backbone predicts discrete action tokens of EEF chunks as an auxiliary task, while a shared flow-matching expert outputs two executable streams, EEF and joint. On a bimanual robot with 22-DoF hands, a matched study shows that discrete supervision helps learn from human data, driving backbone gradients and shaping action-informative representations across domains. Under standard control pipelines at deployment, direct joint readout excels at fine-grained control with robot demonstrations, scoring 0.80 across six tasks against 0.63 for π0.5, whereas IK-based EEF readout excels at human-to-robot transfer. Pretrained with human data and discrete tokens, SHAPE learns new tasks from human demonstrations without task-specific robot data.

papers.title_en: RoboMorpher: Scaling Robot Morphology Representations for Cross-Embodiment Action Prediction
papers.authors: Wenwei Lin, Yan Qin, Weiliang Deng, Zixuan Li, Kaixuan Wang, Zanxin Chen, Yue Chen, Tianshuo Yang, Junting Chen, Zhixuan Liang, Yao Mu, Ximin Lyu, Renjing Xu, Ping Luo, Tianxing Chen
papers.evidence: 面向VLA动作预测的形态条件分词器
papers.tldr: 跨具身操作需要共享动作表示，但相同关节值在不同机器人上会产生不同空间构型。RoboMorpher 提出形态条件动作分词器，联合重建关节角与连杆位姿，并用 MorphGen 生成可扩展运动学监督。其在 4000 万形态-状态对上预训练，冻结后接入 VLA 策略做离散预测与连续细化。在 RoboTwin 2.0 和 EmbodiBench 上分别达 56.40% 与 23.27%，显著优于连续关节空间控制，凸显形态感知几何监督的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Learning shared action representations is central to cross-embodiment manipulation. However, identical joint values can produce different spatial configurations across robots, limiting representations learned from joint values alone. We introduce RoboMorpher, a morphology-conditioned action tokenizer that jointly reconstructs joint angles and link poses to associate control coordinates with their kinematic effects. MorphGen supplies scalable kinematic supervision by generating serial-arm descriptions from survey-derived geometric priors. We pretrain RoboMorpher on 40 million morphology-state pairs and integrate the frozen tokenizer into a vision-language-action policy for discrete prediction and continuous refinement. We also introduce EmbodiBench, a ten-task benchmark with 30 generated URDFs per task. With downstream URDFs excluded from tokenizer pretraining, the policy achieves 56.40% success on RoboTwin 2.0 and 23.27% on EmbodiBench, exceeding continuous joint-space control by 9.73 and 15.34 percentage points. Removing link-pose supervision reduces EmbodiBench success by 17.94 percentage points, supporting morphology-aware geometric supervision for joint-action representation learning.

papers.title_en: $Z$-sight: Unifying Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling
papers.authors: Junjie Ye, Yiqi Zhao, Muchen Xu, Celina Shiyu Wang, Hao Dong, Ruohai Ge, Rong Xue, Benjamin J Kolligs, Aditya Dutt, Sasanka Nagavalli, Nassim A. Samad, Gaurav S. Sukhatme, Jyotirmoy V. Deshmukh, Yue Wang, Yuliang Guo
papers.evidence: 统一视觉-语言-动作与潜在世界建模的机器人基础模型
papers.tldr: 视频世界动作模型可联合预测未来与动作，却承受视频生成的高成本；现有潜空间策略常与VLM原生特征空间解耦。Z-sight 统一VLA与生成式潜世界建模，在VLM感知当前的视觉token空间直接预测未来。它用混合Transformer耦合前瞻专家、连续动作专家与VLM，推理时联合去噪未来空间token和动作，无需像素重建或外部编码器。在SIMPLE达81.9%，六项Unitree G1任务平均73.3%，每块110ms。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce $Z$-sight, a unified robot foundation model that couples vision-language-action (VLA) and generative latent world modeling. Video-based world action models (WAMs) show the value of joint future-and-action generation for control, yet inherit the heavy cost of video generators. Recent latent-space policies avoid pixel generation, yet typically align intermediate features or rely on frozen target encoders, decoupling future prediction from the VLM's native feature space. $Z$-sight instead predicts the future directly in the visual token space in which its VLM perceives the present. Coupling a foresight expert and a continuous action expert with the VLM in a mixture-of-transformers, $Z$-sight jointly denoises future spatial tokens and actions at inference without pixel reconstruction or external encoders. Trained on human video and robot trajectories, $Z$-sight achieves 81.9% success on SIMPLE (+9.6 points over the strongest baseline) and 73.3% across six Unitree G1 tasks (+20.0 points) at 110 ms per chunk, while remaining competitive on tabletop benchmarks.

papers.title_en: WEVO: World Model-Enabled VLA Optimization for Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Qianzhong Chen, Muyuan Lin, Yuyin Sun, Mac Schwager, Cheng-Hao Kuo, Roberto Martín-Martín
papers.evidence: 用世界模型强化学习后训练全身人形视觉-语言-动作策略以完成移动操作
papers.tldr: 人形全身VLA强化学习面临真实探索不安全与仿真残差问题。WEVO无需遥操作，先用仿真操作与运动play数据增强动作条件视频世界模型，再用每任务20次真实rollout对齐部署，并将VLA、WBC与世界模型组成闭环RL环境。三个真实任务上，视频世界模型RL把平均成功率从23.3%提升到75.0%，高于真实机器人RL的48.3%。该框架结合仿真初始化覆盖与部署对齐环境，为全身移动操作后训练提供安全可扩展路径。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) can improve vision-language-action (VLA) policies beyond imitation, but humanoid exploration is unsafe and simulator RL can exploit residual sim-to-real gaps. We present WEVO, a teleoperation-free framework for post-training a whole-body humanoid VLA in an action-conditioned video world model (WM). Simulated manipulation and locomotion play data improve contact-dynamics and viewpoint-change prediction. A VLA trained on synthetic demonstrations collects 20 autonomous real robot rollouts per task to align the WM with deployment observations. The VLA, whole-body controller (WBC), and video WM then form a closed-loop RL environment with dense progress rewards. Across three real robot tasks, play data improves every evaluated WM metric and downstream policy success; video WM RL raises mean success from 23.3% to 75.0%, compared with 48.3% for real robot RL. We therefore leverage the complementary strengths of both environments: simulation provides policy initialization and broad coverage, while the video WM offers a deployment-aligned environment for policy improvement. Project website: https://qianzhong-chen.github.io/wevo.github.io/.

papers.title_en: Don't Lose the Future: Latent-Aware 4-Bit Quantization of World Action Models
papers.authors: Yichen Guo, Yanlong Chen, Xinyue Zhang, Mohan Liu, Song Zhang, Yawei Li
papers.evidence: 4比特权重、激活与KV缓存量化
papers.tldr: 世界动作模型需4比特部署到机器人端侧，但现有量化器只保护输出动作，忽视了预测未来的保真度，动作误差多经退化的未来注入。LAQ用读取者度量衡量未来误差对动作的影响、用读取次数按去噪步加权舍入误差，闭式求解精度分配，并用注视引导精修对关键token做二次4比特处理。LIBERO-Plus上两个模型达76.4%与83.3%，距16比特仅1.2个百分点，压缩3.8倍、提速1.66倍；真机成功率47.0%，比QuaRot高30个百分点。
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) predict how a scene will evolve and condition their actions on this predicted future. Deploying them on a robot's onboard computer calls for 4-bit weights, activations and key-value caches (W4A4KV4). Existing 4-bit quantizers for WAMs preserve the generated action, and estimate sensitivity one denoising step at a time. However, they fail to preserve the fidelity of the predicted future: once the action pathway is protected, the remaining action error enters mostly through a degraded future that none of them deliberately protects. We propose LAQ, a latent-aware quantization framework that preserves the predicted future where it is written, stored and read. Specifically, we introduce a reader metric, which measures future error by its effect on the action, and a read count, which weights each rounding error by the number of denoising steps that read it. Together they give the allocation of precision over activations and caches a closed-form solution. We further develop gaze-guided refinement, which gives the tokens the action attends to a second 4-bit pass in the denoising loop and in the cache. All weights stay at 4 bits, with no high-precision branch and no per-task recalibration. On the LIBERO-Plus benchmark, LAQ reaches 76.4% and 83.3% average success on Fast-WAM and Cosmos-Policy, within 1.2 percentage points of the 16-bit models and all above the baselines with 16-bit KV caches. It compresses the model by 3.8x, reduces the peak GPU memory of the whole policy by 2.3x, and runs 1.66x faster than the 16-bit model. On a real AgileX PiPER arm, it reaches 47.0% average success over three tasks, against 52.0% for the 16-bit model and 30.0% higher than QuaRot.

papers.title_en: CauSyncVLA: Causal Latent World Modeling for Asynchronous Robot Control
papers.authors: Xu Pan, Chubin Zhang, Xingrui Yu, Runmin Lan, Zihao Wang, Wenkai Guo, Bofang Jia, Bo An, Ziwei Wang
papers.evidence: 面向机器人执行的异步双系统VLA控制器
papers.tldr: 视觉语言动作策略在视觉推理未完成时仍需响应，异步重叠计算虽减少等待，却造成感知记忆滞后与动作块不连续。CauSyncVLA用因果潜世界模型从延迟视觉锚点和已执行状态动作历史预测当前感知记忆，并以动作敏感蒸馏保持冻结专家控制响应。再通过预测流热启动对齐未执行动作时域，实现无需额外训练的单步流修正。在LIBERO-10上以5.04倍推理吞吐达到93.8%成功率，提升闭环鲁棒性与运动平滑性。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies must react while visual inference is still running. Overlapping computation and execution reduces waiting, yet leaves perceptual memory stale and successive action chunks disconnected. We present CauSyncVLA, an asynchronous dual-system controller that aligns perceptual-memory prediction and trajectory correction with actual robot execution. Rather than forecasting pixels or physical states, a Causal Latent World Model predicts current perceptual memory from delayed visual anchors and executed state-action history, supervised through action-sensitive distillation to retain the frozen expert's control response. Conditioned on this updated memory, Predictive Flow Warm-Starting (PFWS) aligns the unexecuted action horizon for single-step flow correction without extra training. On LIBERO-10, CauSyncVLA reaches 93.8% success at 5.04$\times$ inference throughput, improving closed-loop robustness and robot motion smoothness.

papers.title_en: Efficient Latent Reasoning for Vision-Language Model via Dynamics-Aware Quantization and Distillation
papers.authors: Yanjing Li, Sheng Xu, Baochang Zhang, Xianbin Cao, Yawei Li
papers.evidence: 面向视觉语言模型隐式推理的动力学感知量化与蒸馏
papers.tldr: 隐式思维链能把文本推理压缩成连续思维，减少中间步骤，但全精度视觉语言模型仍有较高存储与计算开销；直接低比特量化，尤其4-bit权重与激活，会显著损伤推理准确率。为此，作者提出QL-VLM，用动态引导量化保持旋转键结构以减少检索失真，并用动态保持蒸馏对齐连续思维、隐查询读出与预测，维持低精度推理一致性。在ScienceQA-IMG上，4-bit Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct达到90.43%准确率，较基线提升40.33%，比特运算减少16.64倍，实测延迟仅为显式CoT的1/6.40。该工作为高效多模态思维链提供了低比特隐式推理的可行方案。
papers.abstract_en: Efficient chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs) requires reducing both intermediate reasoning steps and their execution cost. Latent CoT methods compress textual rationales into continuous thoughts, yet their full-precision (FP) models retain substantial storage and computation costs. Lowering numerical precision could reduce these remaining costs, yet direct quantization severely degrades reasoning accuracy, particularly with 4-bit weights and activations. Operator and perturbation analyses reveal key sensitivity and direction-dependent predictive effects of continuous-thought errors, motivating preservation of information retrieval and subsequent reasoning beyond reconstruction accuracy. We therefore introduce QL-VLM, a dynamics-aware Quantization framework for efficient Latent reasoning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs). First, Dynamics-Guided Quantization (DGQ) uses nonuniform codebooks that preserve rotary-key structure, mitigating quantization-induced distortion in vision-language information retrieval. Second, Dynamics-Preserving Distillation (DPD) aligns continuous thoughts, latent-query readouts, and predictions with a full-precision teacher, maintaining predictive consistency through subsequent low-precision reasoning. On ScienceQA-IMG with Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct, 4-bit QL-VLM achieves 90.43% accuracy and improves baseline by 40.33%, with 16.64x fewer bit-operations and 6.40x lower measured latency than explicit CoT.

papers.title_en: TipDex-VTLA: Learning When to Refine Actions with Touch for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.authors: Xudi Ge, Yepeng Liu, Haifeng Liu, Enze Shi, Liangqi Zhang, Yongchao Xu
papers.evidence: 带触觉细化的灵巧操作视觉-触觉-语言-动作策略
papers.tldr: 光照变化会在物理状态不变时引发灵巧操作的动作漂移，现有VTLA策略虽引入触觉，却难以判断何时以及如何用触觉修正动作。TipDex-VTLA结合视觉动作可靠性与触觉预测校验来调控执行期修正：VASE从冻结参考策略对光照扰动的动作敏感性学习视觉可靠性，TACE在匹配时刻比较预测与实测触觉，并以视觉可靠性门控有界特征修正。真实四任务与UniVTAC上，正常光照全任务成功率87.5%，挑战未见光照73.8%，显著优于部分SOTA。该工作为不确定视觉下触觉按需修正提供框架。
papers.abstract_en: Changes in illumination can induce action drift in dexterous manipulation even when the physical state remains unchanged. Although existing vision--tactile--language--action (VTLA) policies incorporate tactile feedback, when and how touch refines actions under changing visual conditions remains challenging. We introduce \textbf{TipDex-VTLA}, a VTLA policy that combines estimated visual action reliability and tactile forecast verification to regulate execution-time refinement. Specifically, Visual Action Sensitivity Estimation (VASE) learns visual reliability from a frozen reference policy's action sensitivity to illumination perturbations. Tactile Anticipation and Correction during Execution (TACE) compares predicted and measured touch at matched times and combines the resulting discrepancy with visual reliability to gate bounded feature corrections for unexecuted actions. This effectively helps to refine actions under challenging unseen visual conditions. We evaluate TipDex-VTLA on four real-world dexterous manipulation tasks and the UniVTAC simulation benchmark. TipDex-VTLA trained on data collected under normal visual conditions, achieves average full-task success rates of 87.5% (resp. 73.8%) under normal (resp. challenging unseen) lighting in real-world tasks, significantly outperforming some state-of-the-art methods. We will release the collected data and source code.

papers.title_en: VR-SparseQuant: Accurate FP4 Quantization with 2:4 Sparsity on Vera Rubin
papers.authors: Samir Khaki, Wei-Chen Wang, Song Han, Ryan Hanrui Wang
papers.evidence: 面向大模型服务的 FP4 激活量化与 2:4 稀疏结合
papers.tldr: 4稀疏，让两条稀疏流共享同一FP4数值预算，并以离线尺度比校准和共享权重GEMM高效累加。在Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B上，WikiText-2困惑度由6.85降至5.57，原生内核相对BF16最高取得3.1倍GEMM和2.7倍MoE加速。该工作首次研究基于Vera Rubin稀疏FP4指令的自适应激活量化，在保持原生FP4执行的同时提升精度与效率。
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, GPUs have incorporated increasingly specialized support for low-precision computation, from Hopper's FP8 to Blackwell's FP4 Tensor Cores. Precision formats have evolved alongside this hardware, from MXFP4 and NVFP4 on Blackwell to E2M1 FP4 with direct UE5M3 block scaling on Vera Rubin, which we term as $\boldsymbol{VRFP4}$. These advances help serve larger language models at lower cost, but four-bit activation quantization can substantially degrade model quality. We introduce VR-SparseQuant, which uses Vera Rubin's elementwise 2:4 sparsity to recover accuracy while retaining native FP4 execution. By allowing two sparse streams to overlap, we use the same FP4 value budget as dense quantization to refine activations with larger errors. Offline scale-ratio calibration avoids runtime search, while a shared-weight GEMM accumulates both streams efficiently. On Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B, VR-SparseQuant reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from $\boldsymbol{6.85}$ to $\boldsymbol{5.57}$ versus dense RTN W4A4. Including activation preparation, our native Rubin kernels for VRFP4 achieve up to $\boldsymbol{3.1\times}$ GEMM and $\boldsymbol{2.7\times}$ MoE speedup over BF16. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study of adaptive activation quantization using Vera Rubin's elementwise 2:4 structured sparse FP4 instructions.

papers.title_en: NariQ: Sub-3-Bit Quantization for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
papers.authors: Doyeob Kim
papers.evidence: 面向大语言模型的网格编码后训练量化
papers.tldr: 长程智能体任务需要在十万级上下文里多步调用工具，但现有低比特量化多基于短网页文本校准、用困惑度评估，导致量化模型在 DeepSWE 等长程基准上明显落后。NariQ 提出基于网格编码（trellis-coded）的训练后量化，并用 BF16 模型在智能体会话中生成的 token 做校准。在 Qwen3.8-27B 上，3.0 与 2.5 比特权重在 DeepSWE、Terminal Bench 及 AIME、RealWorldQA 上与 BF16 持平，为首批在长程智能体任务上追平全精度的 3 比特以下量化，并开源 GGUF 权重与推理分支。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agentic tasks require a model to call tools over many steps at contexts of 100K tokens or more, yet many low-bit quantization methods are calibrated on short web text and judged on perplexity. This mismatch is costly: existing quantizations of Qwen3.8-27B at or below 3 bits per weight match BF16 on shorter tasks like AIME, yet in published results solve at most 72% as many tasks as BF16 on DeepSWE, a long-horizon agentic benchmark. We propose NariQ, a trellis-coded post-training quantization method that calibrates on tokens generated by the BF16 model in agent sessions. On Qwen3.8-27B, NariQ at 3.0 and 2.5 bits per weight stays level with BF16 on two long-horizon agentic benchmarks, DeepSWE and Terminal Bench, as well as on AIME and RealWorldQA. Our checkpoint at 2.0 bits per weight trails this performance. To our knowledge, these are the first quantizations at or below 3 bits per weight shown to match their full-precision version on long-horizon agentic tasks. We release the files as Qwen3.8-27B-NariQ-GGUF (https://huggingface.co/nari-labs/Qwen3.8-27B-NariQ-GGUF), with inference available through our llama.cpp fork at https://github.com/nari-labs/nari-llama.cpp.

papers.title_en: One View, One Action: Spatially Generalizable VLAs through Observation-Aligned Experts and Cross Graph Consistency
papers.authors: Jinxi Liu, Ruifeng Zhai, Hao Liu, Guangrun Wang
papers.evidence: 空间可泛化的视觉-语言-动作模型
papers.tldr: 多视角VLA在相机视角和机器人初始状态变化时空间泛化不足，且通常仅在基座系监督动作。OVOA-VLA改为在各视图相机系预测动作，并联合训练基座专家与视图专家，用双向有向注意力图和跨图一致性利用观测对齐监督。LIBERO-Plus上完整与仅基座推理平均成功率达88.1%和85.7%，真实任务仅基座推理将π0.5的28.3%提升至58.3%，增强空间分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view vision-language-action (VLA) models still face challenges in spatial generalization, particularly under changes in camera viewpoints and robot initial states. These models typically receive action supervision only in the robot base frame, requiring them to implicitly learn the spatial correspondence between observations from each view and base-frame actions. We propose One View, One Action (OVOA-VLA), which learns to predict actions in each view's camera frame, allowing the same physical motion to provide diverse, observation-aligned supervision across views. OVOA-VLA jointly trains a base-frame expert and view-specific action experts, whose robot-state inputs and action targets are expressed in their respective camera frames. Two complementary directed attention graphs model both directions of interaction between the base and view-specific experts, jointly leveraging view-specific action supervision to improve base-frame prediction. Cross Graph Consistency further encourages agreement between the two graphs' base-frame predictions for the same sample. With the same multi-view inputs, the model supports both full and base-only inference. Experiments across multiple simulation benchmarks demonstrate improved manipulation performance and robustness to camera-viewpoint and robot-initialization perturbations. Full and base-only inference achieve average success rates of 88.1% and 85.7% on LIBERO-Plus, respectively. In real-world evaluations, base-only inference raises the average success rates from $π_{0.5}$'s 28.3% to 58.3% across three tasks under spatial distribution shifts.

papers.title_en: Risk-Controlled Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Zixuan Liu, Hashem Haghbayan, Zizhan Zheng, Siavash Khajavi
papers.evidence: 面向可靠机器人操作适配的风险受控检索增强VLA。
papers.tldr: 检索增强VLA可在不更新参数下利用专家演示做测试时适应，但即使检索到相关演示，模型也可能无法有效利用而失败。R2-VLA学习不确定性预测器判断动作可靠性，并校准任务级风险阈值，在需要时请求专家协助。实验在三个VLA骨干和四个LIBERO套件上平均提升任务成功率9.2–11.2个百分点，且专家请求更少。该工作将检索演示有用性与任务级风险控制连接，提升机器人操作适应可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) models enable efficient test-time adaptation by leveraging expert demonstrations as additional context without updating model parameters. However, even when retrieved demonstrations are relevant to the current task, the VLA may fail to effectively utilize the retrieved information, ultimately leading to task failure. To address this challenge, we propose R2-VLA, a risk-controlled retrieval-augmented VLA framework that enables reliable test-time adaptation by satisfying a user-specified task success rate requirement with minimal expert assistance. Specifically, R2-VLA learns an uncertainty predictor that estimates the uncertainty of the VLA's predicted actions given the retrieved demonstrations, guiding when to act autonomously or request expert assistance. We further introduce a task-level risk-control procedure that calibrates the uncertainty threshold to satisfy a user-specified task-failure risk requirement. Moreover, R2-VLA continually incorporates expert corrections into its retrieval memory to improve future adaptation while preserving the prescribed task-level risk guarantee. Experiments across three VLA backbones and four LIBERO benchmark suites demonstrate that R2-VLA improves average task success by 9.2--11.2 percentage points, achieving the desired target with fewer expert requests. These results highlight the effectiveness of connecting the usefulness of retrieved demonstrations with task-level risk control to enable successful robotic manipulation.

papers.title_en: ESI: An Embodied Self-Improvement Flywheel for LLM-VLA Agents
papers.authors: Yundi Cai, Zihan Wang, Chenxi Han, Yi Cheng, Houde Liu, Zilei Wang
papers.evidence: 通过具身自我改进对齐LLM推理与VLA控制策略
papers.tldr: LLM与VLA分别提供推理与执行能力，但简单拼接会导致动作偏离子任务，且纠正后可能破坏已恢复状态。ESI把模块化智能体作为后训练单元，利用交互中的语义监督与动作级纠正信号，联合迭代LLM提示、共享技能接口和VLA参数。在RoboDojo十个任务上，无需任务专用控制代码即取得62.03分和49.41%成功率。该方法表明协作过程本身可成为监督来源，为具身智能体自我改进提供可复用飞轮。
papers.abstract_en: Independently pretrained language models and vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide complementary building blocks for embodied agents, but connecting them does not automatically produce coordinated behavior. The VLA may generate actions that diverge from the LLM's intended subtask and, upon regaining control after a correction, undo the promising state restored by the LLM. We introduce ESI (Embodied Self-Improvement), an automated flywheel that uses environmental interaction to align reasoning and action. ESI treats the modular agent as the unit of post-training, repeatedly refining the prompts that guide the LLM, the shared skill interface that expresses its intent, and the VLA parameters that realize that intent, then redeploying these components together. Our key insight is that collaboration itself can supply supervision for improving this interface. The LLM's subtask decisions provide semantic supervision for what the policy should execute, while its effective corrections and subsequent student continuations provide action-level supervision for recovery and handoff. The student also learns from its own effective execution, allowing locally useful experience to contribute even when the overall episode fails. On ten selected RoboDojo tasks, ESI achieves a mean Score of 62.03 and a mean success rate of 49.41% using an LLM-VLA agent without generating task-specific control code. On both metrics, it outperforms the published reference results of all hybrid embodied agents, including the Agent+WAM system GO-3 Nano Preview (47.27 Score and 36.60% success), as well as all compared code-based methods.

papers.title_en: Wireless Edge-Assisted Adaptive Latent Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models in Physical AI
papers.authors: Fatih Temiz, Melike Erol-Kantarci
papers.evidence: 面向具身控制VLA模型的边缘协同推理与潜在推理
papers.tldr: VLA模型在物理AI中面临算力与实时通信约束，潜空间推理虽可提升任务表现，却带来时延和能耗权衡。为此，作者提出无线边缘辅助自适应潜空间推理框架WEALR，将执行位置与推理收敛阈值联合决策建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程，并用TRPO-Lag学习策略。在LIBERO任务、实测VLA开销与射线追踪信道下，该方法相较基准CDRL将可行性加权任务成功率最高提升23%。该工作为受限资源下的VLA协同推理提供了通信感知的自适应方案。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable embodied artificial intelligence (AI) by translating visual observations and language instructions into robotic actions. Emerging use cases in physical AI are expected to drive the need for efficient inference and communication, as the computational demands of the VLA models pose challenges for real-time control with limited onboard resources. Test-time scaling through latent reasoning allows these models to refine hidden representations without generating explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens, but introduces a trade-off between task success, inference latency, and energy consumption. In this paper, we address the efficient collaborative inference under a realistic communication scenario. We propose a wireless edge-assisted framework for adaptive latent reasoning (WEALR) that augments onboard computation with edge computing. A decision-making agent jointly selects the execution location and latent-reasoning convergence threshold. We formulate this joint adaptation as a constrained Markov decision process (CMDP). A Lagrangian-constrained deep reinforcement learning (CDRL) approach, namely trust region policy optimization Lagrangian (TRPO-Lag), learns to balance task performance and resource consumption under varying wireless conditions and task requirements. We evaluate the framework using LIBERO manipulation tasks, profiled VLA inference costs, and ray-traced wireless channels. Experimental results demonstrate that TRPO-Lag achieves up to 23% higher feasibility-weighted task success rate compared to benchmark CDRL methods.

papers.title_en: ResWAM: Learning What Changes, Not What Stays, for World-Action Models
papers.authors: Chongyu Fan, Gaowen Liu, Ramana Rao Kompella, Jason Corso, Sijia Liu
papers.evidence: 以未来预测增强视觉-语言-动作策略的世界-动作模型
papers.tldr: 现有世界动作模型监督完整未来观测，损失易被静态背景主导，任务相关运动学习不足且计算开销大。ResWAM改为在冻结DINOv3空间监督帧间特征残差，并用轻量双分支DiT联合训练动作与残差。无机器人预训练下，它在多个仿真基准取得领先成功率，训练与推理算力最低，并在真实机器人任务上优于π0.5。该工作以残差世界建模提升策略性能与闭环部署效率。
papers.abstract_en: World-action models (WAMs) augment vision-language-action policies (VLAs) with future prediction so that the policy can anticipate how its actions will affect the physical world. Existing WAMs supervise complete future observations. However, observations typically change little over an action chunk, so the future loss is dominated by copying static background content rather than learning task-relevant robot and object motion, limiting policy learning. Moreover, existing WAMs rely on large video generation models or separate world models, incurring heavy training and inference compute that hinders closed-loop deployment. To improve policy performance, we propose visual residual learning, supervising only the feature change from the current frame to the future frame in a frozen DINOv3 space. Compared with complete future features, this residual learning target yields a higher feature rank with richer and more diverse representations of scene changes, and spatially concentrates on the robot arm and manipulated objects rather than the background. To further improve computational efficiency, we present ResWAM, a residual world-action model with 2.3B parameters in total, including a lightweight 0.5B dual-branch DiT that jointly trains an action branch and a residual branch via conditional flow matching. Without robot pretraining (i.e., pretraining on external robot action trajectories beyond the benchmark demonstrations), ResWAM achieves top average success rates on LIBERO-Plus (81.1%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.8%), and RoboDojo (9.40% success, 13.41 score) at the lowest training (2.7-4.0 TFLOPs) and inference compute (1.0-1.4 TFLOPs), and leads real-robot Open, Put, and Stack (80.0% average, +10.0% over $π_{0.5}$) at 92.7 ms latency.

papers.title_en: ACiT: Proprioceptive-Prior Action Chunking with Inverted Transformers
papers.authors: Haixiang Wu, Zhihao Guan, Yang Yang
papers.evidence: 视觉运动策略从视觉与本体感受观测学习动作预测
papers.tldr: 视觉运动策略通常将本体感觉历史与高维视觉同等融合，导致本体信号被淹没。ACiT 以关节间耦合为本体先验，用倒置状态编码、状态-视觉对齐和倒置动作分块，让视觉仅做目标校准。在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 和真实任务上多数成功率提升，动力学与协调任务增益最大。该条件设计迁移至 VLA 主干 pi_0-ACiT 后也显著提升并改善执行效率。
papers.abstract_en: Visuomotor policies condition action prediction on visual and proprioceptive observations. While historical proprioceptive sequences carry rich dynamic priors, current methods treat them as equal to high-dimensional vision, causing the proprioceptive signal to be overwhelmed. To identify what is lost in equal-conditioning fusion, we analyze proprioceptive data and find that strong inter-joint coupling is the key action-determining structure. This finding aligns with the neural sensorimotor loop, in which proprioception first forms a body-centered prior and vision is later calibrated via parietal remapping. Inspired by this, we propose ACiT, Proprioceptive-Prior Action Chunking with Inverted Transformers, which reinforces historical joint-coupling as the primary condition with vision as a later calibration. This design is instantiated through three modules: Inverted State Encoding builds a proprioceptive prior via per-joint tokens and inter-joint self-attention. State-Visual Grounding lets joint tokens query visual evidence, making vision goal- and calibration-only. Inverted Action Chunking decodes per-joint trajectories independently. ACiT improves success rates on most LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world tasks, with the largest gains on those that require dynamics and coordination. The same conditioning design transferred to the VLA backbone pi_0-ACiT yields significant gains with better execution efficiency.

papers.title_en: One Model, Two Precisions: Does Disagreement Between Quantized Copies Tell You When a Small Model Is Wrong?
papers.authors: Mohammed Nayeem Khan, Allan Kevin T
papers.evidence: 小语言模型低比特量化与跨精度分歧的错误评分
papers.tldr: 量化会改变小模型单题答案，但同权重不同精度间的分歧能否作为逐题错误分数仍待验证。作者在Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B上模拟3–6位分组量化，用8位与低精度副本的分歧做弃答、升级和重问信号。0.6B上最佳分歧AUROC仅0.684，较熵0.682增益微弱；与置信度特征结合提升0.009。高斯噪声对照和特征打乱显示信号不特异于量化，额外8位换序前向更有效，等流量下升级大模型更优。
papers.abstract_en: Local language models often exist at several precisions, and quantization is known to change individual answers. This study asks whether the disagreement between two precisions of the same weights, an 8-bit copy that answers and a lower-precision copy that reads the same prompt, works as a per-question error score for abstention, escalation and re-asking. The cost is one extra forward pass over fewer bytes, with no sampling and no training. We simulate round-to-nearest quantization with per-group scales (3 to 6 bits, groups of 32 to 256) on Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B and score 8,398 multiple-choice questions from ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, MMLU and HellaSwag subsets. Error detection is measured by AUROC, risk-coverage curves and ECE on a held-out half, with paired bootstrap intervals over questions. For Qwen3-0.6B, the entropy of the 8-bit answer reaches AUROC 0.682; the best disagreement score, selected on a development half, reaches 0.684 (+0.001 [-0.009, +0.011]), and combining it with the confidence features adds +0.009 [+0.002, +0.015], mostly on ARC. On Qwen3-1.7B the selected score is -0.001 [-0.009, +0.006] from entropy and the combination +0.003 [-0.001, +0.006] on the test half. Gaussian weight noise at matched error energy is about as informative as rounding (0.6B only), so we find no evidence that the signal is specific to quantization, and shuffling the features within task and entropy cells removes the gain. One extra 8-bit pass that shifts the option order does better (+0.049 [+0.031, +0.067] over entropy) at about a third more weight traffic; routing to a larger model on free entropy beats both extra-pass scores at equal total traffic. After logistic recalibration the 0.6B confidences are calibrated within a few points of ECE. A deployment recipe and the cases where the method does not help are given.

papers.title_en: SALA: Semantically Aligned Latent Actions Enable Dual-Axis Scaling of Embodied Foundation Models
papers.authors: Jiachun Jin, Zetong Zhou, Haonan Wang, Zhijie Deng
papers.evidence: 为具身基础模型学习语义对齐的潜在动作以监督机器人策略
papers.tldr: 具身基础模型受限于昂贵机器人交互数据，人类第一人称视频可补充经验，但现有潜在动作模型仅靠视频重建，表示易按视觉外观而非底层动作聚类，跨具身对齐困难。SALA无需配对数据，以人类与机器人片段的语言描述估计语义相似性，用软邻域结构监督潜在动作的跨具身语义对应，并用机器人动作重建锚定控制。该共享潜在动作空间支持双轴缩放：增加通用人类视频预训练降低下游动作预测误差，增加任务特定人类视频后训练提升真实机器人成功率，为利用人类视频扩展具身基础模型提供语义对齐监督。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied foundation models hinge on diverse robot interaction data, which are costly to collect. Egocentric human videos offer a complementary source of experience, and latent action models (LAMs) provide a popular means of leveraging these videos for policy supervision. Compared with world-action models (WAMs), LAMs can offer greater training efficiency and potentially lower inference costs by avoiding explicit pixel prediction during policy learning and execution. However, most existing LAMs learn latent actions solely through video reconstruction, which can cause their representations to cluster by visual appearance rather than by the underlying actions. As a result, they struggle to align human actions with their robot counterparts. To bridge the gap, we introduce SALA, which emphasizes establishing the semantic correspondence for latent actions. Without requiring paired data, we use the language descriptions of unpaired human and robot clips to estimate semantic similarities and supervise cross-embodiment correspondence. Specifically, we translate these similarities into soft neighborhood structures that guide human latent actions toward semantically related robot latents, while robot action reconstruction grounds the latent space in control. The resulting shared latent action space provides a unified supervision signal for training an embodied foundation model on both human and robot videos. Notably, latent action supervision enables scaling along two axes: (1) pre-training on increasing amounts of general human video consistently reduces robot action prediction error on downstream tasks, and (2) post-training on increasing amounts of task-specific human video substantially improves real-world robot task success rates.

papers.title_en: On the Utility of Pre-Trained Visual Representations for Policy Learning of Contact-Rich Insertion Tasks
papers.authors: Leon Kim, Dinesh Jayaraman, Michael Posa
papers.evidence: 比较预训练视觉表征在插入任务视觉运动模仿策略学习中的作用
papers.tldr: 视觉运动模仿学习在机器人操作中数据效率低且易受无关视觉变化干扰，预训练视觉表征能否缓解仍无定论。论文聚焦接触丰富的插入任务，比较常用视觉基础模型表征与显式接触中心表征，并在两个相近插入任务上系统扰动遮挡与物理容差，同时验证仿真到真实迁移。结果显示最佳表征连近乎相同的任务间也会变化，但空间接地尤其是接触中心信息对策略学习具有独特价值。研究强调接触线索在真实视觉复杂度和传感器噪声下难以可靠估计，呼吁加强接触感知及其与视觉运动策略的融合。
papers.abstract_en: Visuomotor imitation learning has become a predominant paradigm for real-world robotic manipulation, yet it remains data-inefficient and brittle to task-irrelevant visual shifts. Pre-trained visual representations promise to ease this burden by distilling priors from internet-scale data, but the ``right'' representation for robotics remains unresolved: existing studies span broad but sparse task distributions and reach conclusions that vary and even conflict, pointing to strong task and setting dependence. We examine this question by bringing a magnifying glass to a common contact-rich manipulation task: insertion. We compare representations from widely used vision foundation models against an explicit contact-centric representation on two closely related insertion tasks, perturb each along controlled axes of occlusion and physical tolerance, and test whether conclusions transfer to the real world. Task dependence proves to be more subtle than previous, broadly scoped evaluations revealed: the best representation differs even between our near-identical tasks, and small changes shift trends in unpredictable ways. Despite this variability, results across simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate the distinct value of spatially-grounded, and in particular, contact-centric information for contact-rich policy learning, while underscoring how difficult it is to estimate such cues reliably under realistic visual complexity and sensor noise. We hope these findings motivate further study of representations in contact-rich manipulation, along with advances in contact perception and its integration into visuomotor policy learning.

papers.title_en: TIVS: Mapping the Sensitivity Landscape of Visual Token Transformations in MLLMs
papers.authors: Yikang Qiao, Jianye Zeng, Duan Huang, Ziying Song
papers.evidence: 多模态大模型中视觉token的数值精度与变换敏感度分析
papers.tldr: 多模态大模型的视觉 token 剪枝、量化和压缩常假定变换后的 token 仍可被冻结解码器使用，但这些变换的敏感特性尚不清楚。作者提出免训练干预框架 TIVS，在受控条件下分别研究序列置换、token 保留、数值精度与统计替换。在 POPE 的 192 题上，三种置换平均仅改变 TinyLLaVA 准确率 -0.17 个百分点，却改变 4.69% 的个体预测；对角与秩 64 高斯替换则分别下降 25.0 与 28.1 个百分点。该工作为评估视觉 token 变换与设计可靠多模态接口提供实证依据。
papers.abstract_en: Recent efforts to improve the efficiency of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have explored visual token pruning, quantization, and feature compression. However, the properties that determine whether transformed visual tokens remain usable by a frozen decoder are not well characterized. We introduce \textbf{TIVS (Token Identity Versus Statistics)}, a training-free intervention framework that separately studies sequence permutation, token retention, numerical precision, and statistical replacement under controlled conditions. On 192 POPE questions, three token permutations change TinyLLaVA accuracy by only $-0.17$ percentage points on average, while changing 4.69\% of individual predictions. Diagonal and rank-64 Gaussian replacements decrease accuracy by 25.0 and 28.1 points on the same subset. Further experiments with exact moment constraints, quantization error, token retention, and additional visual tasks reveal how strongly the effects depend on the original feature values and the evaluation setting. These findings provide an empirical basis for assessing visual token transformations in frozen MLLMs and designing more reliable multimodal interfaces.

papers.title_en: Lost Between Mind, Model Collaboration, and Motion: Understanding and Measuring Cross-Model Action Misalignment in Commercial Robots
papers.authors: Yuhang Huang, Junchao Li, Boyang Ma, Minghui Xu, Kaidi Xu, Pengfei Hu, Xiuzhen Cheng, Yue Zhang
papers.evidence: 度量大模型意图理解与机器人动作模型之间的语义失配
papers.tldr: 商用具身机器人依赖LLM理解意图并协同动作模型执行，跨“意图理解—模型协作—物理运动”的语义边界可能断裂，导致无显式动作指令时仍产生非预期行为。TARS以黑盒方式探索命令-推理-动作流水线，自动发现并验证此类跨模型动作错位。在四款商用机器人、44种设置下执行133,400次，TARS揭示错位普遍存在，验证动作覆盖率最高达94%，为商用机器人安全评估提供可量化手段。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied robots increasingly rely on large language models (LLMs) to interpret user intent and coordinate with robot-specific action models for physical interaction. This multi-model pipeline creates a critical semantic boundary across mind, model collaboration, and motion: semantic consistency may break between what the large model understands, how the small action model translates that understanding into executable commands, and what physical actions the robot ultimately performs. As a security consequence, commercial robots may execute unintended physical actions even when user inputs contain no explicit action commands. To measure this problem, we develop TARS, a black-box framework that explores the command-reasoning-action pipeline and automatically discovers and validates unintended physical behaviors. We evaluate TARS on four commercial robots across 44 experimental settings, conducting 133,400 executions. TARS uncovers widespread cross-model action misalignment and achieves up to 94% verified action coverage.

papers.title_en: Latent Action Policies from Suboptimal Data
papers.authors: Donghyeon Ki, Xiaoyu Chen, Jun Ho Seo, Hayeong Lee, Kyungyoon Kim, Byung-Jun Lee, Li Zhao
papers.evidence: 从无动作视频中学习潜在动作控制策略并分析离线强化学习条件
papers.tldr: 潜动作模型可从无动作视频学习控制表征，但现有流程多用行为克隆训练潜策略，缺少显式策略改进。标准离线强化学习难以直接迁移到学到的潜动作空间，朴素值最大化或单峰策略会生成物理不可执行的潜动作。为此，作者提出LAPIS，将值改进锚定在观测到的状态—潜动作转移上，并用条件流策略建模多峰结构。多数任务上优于基线，视觉操作提升最明显，仅1%动作标签仍有效。
papers.abstract_en: Latent Action Models (LAMs) learn control representations from action-free video, but existing pipelines typically train latent policies with behavioral cloning, without an explicit policy improvement objective. Although offline RL offers a natural approach to policy improvement, standard methods do not transfer directly to learned latent action spaces. We find that the structure of learned latent actions makes naive offline RL unreliable: directly maximizing value over latent actions or fitting a unimodal policy can produce latent actions that cannot be realized by physical execution, while the latent representation can merge physical controls that receive different rewards. To understand when latent-space optimization remains valid, we derive conditions under which policy improvement transfers to decoded execution and under which latent and physical optima align. Building on these insights, we propose LAPIS for goal-conditioned latent policy improvement, grounding value-based policy improvement in observed state-latent transitions and using a conditional flow policy to capture their multimodal structure. LAPIS outperforms baselines on most tasks, with the clearest gains in visual manipulation, and remains effective even with only 1% action labels, where competing methods largely collapse.

papers.title_en: RECLAIM: Robot-Vision-Informed Adversarial Patch Defense via Embodied Attention Feedback
papers.authors: Jiayou Zhu, Peng Guo, Litian Zhang, Xinze Shi, Yuting Zhang, Zelong Yu, Yize Tian, Jirong Liu, Zifeng Kang
papers.evidence: 面向具身操作VLA策略的免训练防御
papers.tldr: 视觉-语言-动作策略通过感知-动作闭环控制具身智能体，对抗性补丁会污染动作预测并改变后续观测。RECLAIM 提出免训练、推理时的防御：利用冻结 VLA 对局部视觉干预的注意力变化作为反馈，结合机器人几何定位补丁并选择净化方式，在闭环交互中反复校验。在四类攻击、多个操作任务上，95% 任务至少一次成功，LIBERO-Object 成功率从 0% 升至 70.0%，每控制步决策仅 548.9 ms。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action policies control embodied agents through a perception-action loop grounded in physical interaction, where adversarial patches can corrupt action predictions and thereby alter subsequent observations. To mitigate these threats, many existing defenses rely on policy adaptation or auxiliary models, but require additional training or inference. We introduce RECLAIM, a training-free, inference-time defense that uses a frozen VLA's own attention response to local visual interventions to guide purification during closed-loop embodied manipulation. Our key insight is that attention changes induced by local edits provide feedback for choosing where and how to purify as the robot interacts with its environment. RECLAIM combines this feedback with robot geometry to refine patch localization and select local treatments, then revalidates them as the agent's embodied actions change the observed scene. We evaluate RECLAIM against patches generated by four adversarial attack methods across multiple manipulation task suites under frozen VLA control. Under adversarial patch attacks, RECLAIM succeeds in at least one rollout on 95% of the evaluated tasks and raises rollout success on LIBERO-Object from 0% without defense to 70.0%. Its mean decision time is only 548.9 ms per control step. These results highlight policy-guided visual purification as an effective approach to defending embodied agents against adversarial patches and recovering closed-loop task execution.
